'''899 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in the era known as the [[Great Peace of the Republic]].

==Notable events==
*The [[Pact of Almera]] is signed between the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] and the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]], recognizing the [[Thyrsian]]s' independence from the [[Echani Command]].<ref name="EGTWACp2" />
